offence_note: Underage sexual intercourse and illicit intercourse with foster daughter (1978)
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal sentence, allow the appeal and set aside the sentence imposed by the sentencing judge. I would impose a sentence of three years.
note: Conditional sentence replaced by 3 years with 1 year credit for time served under conditional sentence.

offence_note: Failing to stop after fatal accident; obstructing justice
sentence_quote: I am sentencing you to a term of ten months' imprisonment for the offence of leaving the scene of an accident and to a sentence of two months, to be served concurrently, for the offence of obstructing justice.
note: No additional driving prohibition because of automatic suspension and bail credit.

offence_note: Municipal tree protection by-law offences by a company
sentence_quote: reducing the fines that were imposed on these counts by $1000 each. This results in total fines of $33,000

offence_note: Assault, use of firearm in assault, unsafe firearm storage
sentence_quote: I would dismiss the conviction appeal. I would grant leave to appeal sentence but dismiss the sentence appeal.
note: One year mandatory minimum on firearm count; suspended sentence and 1 year probation on other counts.

offence_note: Sexual assault and sexual touching of young step-daughter
sentence_quote: it is the sentence of this Court that you be incarcerated in a federal institution for a period of two years and six months. The same sentence shall apply to the second charge concurrent.

offence_note: Impaired driving and flight from police
sentence_quote: For these reasons, I would dismiss the appeal and the cross-appeal.
note: Court of Appeal outcome stands: conditional discharge on evading police; minimum fine (amount not shown) for impaired driving.

offence_note: Offences not shown; described as very serious crimes

note: Endorsement does not state offences or sentence.

offence_note: Home invasion robbery, imitation firearm use, loaded prohibited firearm
sentence_quote: I conclude that a global sentence of eight years' imprisonment is appropriate including: six years for the robbery; one year consecutive for the use of an imitation firearm; and one year imprisonment for the possession of the loaded prohibited firearm
